WITH facts AS ( SELECT project_id,progress,occurred_at,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY project_id ORDER BY occurred_at DESC,fact_version DESC,id DESC) rn FROM proj_project_progress_fact WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND deleted=b'0' AND project_id ), snapshots AS ( SELECT project_id,progress,calculated_at,snapshot_status,tree_version, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY project_id ORDER BY calculated_at DESC,id DESC) rn FROM proj_project_progress_snapshot WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND deleted=b'0' AND project_id ), children AS ( SELECT ancestor_project_id,COUNT(*) total, SUM(CASE WHEN descendant_project_id
IN #{id} IN (NULL) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) hidden FROM proj_project_tree_path WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND root_project_id=#{query.rootProjectId} AND tree_version=#{query.treeVersion} AND distance>0 AND deleted=b'0' AND ancestor_project_id GROUP BY ancestor_project_id ) SELECT p.id AS projectId, CASE WHEN COALESCE(c.hidden,0)>0 THEN NULL WHEN c.total IS NULL THEN f.progress WHEN s.tree_version=#{query.treeVersion} AND s.snapshot_status='READY' THEN s.progress ELSE NULL END AS progress, CASE WHEN COALESCE(c.hidden,0)>0 THEN 'RESTRICTED' WHEN c.total IS NULL THEN IF(f.progress IS NULL,'PENDING','READY') WHEN s.tree_version IS NOT NULL AND s.tree_version!=#{query.treeVersion} THEN 'STALE' WHEN s.snapshot_status='READY' AND s.progress IS NOT NULL THEN 'READY' ELSE 'PENDING' END AS status, CASE WHEN COALESCE(c.hidden,0)>0 THEN NULL WHEN c.total IS NULL THEN f.occurred_at ELSE s.calculated_at END AS recordedAt FROM proj_project p LEFT JOIN children c ON c.ancestor_project_id=p.id LEFT JOIN facts f ON f.project_id=p.id AND f.rn=1 LEFT JOIN snapshots s ON s.project_id=p.id AND s.rn=1 WHERE p.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND p.deleted=b'0' AND p.id
